author: Slidebean
description:
AI’s real bottleneck isn’t code

Microsoft may reactivate Three Mile Island to power AI data centers.

Sounds simple.
It’s not.

You can’t plug a data center into a nuclear plant.
You need substations and transformers and those are backlogged for years in the U.S.

AI’s constraint isn’t intelligence.
It’s infrastructure.

title: AI doesn’t have a software problem
